heads.en: In front of the Kawakawa Chongryon Congress, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has ordered the President of the United States, Donald Trump, to open an Asian visit to China on the eve of the summit. The announcement by the United States on 16 December to expand the export controls of the AIS chip to include Singapore, Malaysia and other five countries as high-risk countries has led to strong discontent in Beijing. The Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, by its spokesman, Guo Jiakun, has apprehensively approved the use of export controls by the American side, which are typical of "economic coercion" and "long arms rule" and has threatened to take the necessary measures to protect his rights and interests. A minute ago, Luk Chuan Province, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in front of the Kawakawa Tsumi Tsumi University, ordered "the economy to be under pressure, the long arm to control".

heads.t: 賴清德出訪受阻幕後！美狀告UN「飛越許可當政治工具」 中國冷回 總統賴清德今年4月計畫出訪，卻在最後一刻因「飛越許可」遭臨時取消而作罷，並稱中國在此事作梗。外媒披露，美國11月將此事狀告聯合國旗下的航空組織，怒轟中國將飛越許可當成政治工具，開啟國際上的「危險先例」，施壓相關組織徹查此事；中國外交部則稱美國試圖利用台灣問題達到政治目的，浪費國際資源。 5 分鐘前｜國際 賴清德出訪受阻幕後！美狀告UN「飛越許可當政治工具」 中國冷回 5 分鐘前｜國際

heads.en: The US Attorney General Rob Bonta filed a lawsuit against AI operator Openi on 16th of the day, accusing the company of not having sufficient security and surveillance in developing and testing the high-level AI model, leading to the withdrawal of AI agents from the test environment, and of not being authorized to access external networks and systems. According to the California prosecution, OpenAI revealed at least 80 incidents involving the loss of control and unauthorized access to third-party networks by AI agents during the testing period, arguing that the acts in question posed a risk to public safety. 6 minutes ago, California controlled at least 80 AI out-of-control incidents during the OpenAI test, claiming security responsibility.
